remarks: Now is your time to enjoy the gracious easy lifestyle at Sterling Lake, a prized gated community of just 13-free-standing homes nr everything, but a world apart-where mowing, landscaping & snow removal is done for you! Sited on the cul-de-sac w/perfect privacy, this elegant sun-filled home has been beautifully updated & maintained w/gleaming hdwd flrs & lush carpets, vaulted ceilings & walls of windows that include a number of dramatic Palladian & bay windows that fill the home w/light & views - feature sheet tells more! It even boasts a spectacular Main Floor Primary suite that has a dressing area w/2-custom outfitted WI closets+2-add'l closets, roomy BR w/crown molding & bay window alcove and designer bath that has marble topped double sink vanity, soaking tub & new shower. Open flow from dynamic Great room w/fireplace & soaring beamed ceiling to the formal Dining rm w/vaulted ceiling extends to the stunning redesigned gourmet EIK w/granite countertops, lg center island, gas cooktop, double ovens, abundant cabinetry & charming casual dining area w/sliders to wrap deck. Office w/handsome built-ins, a stylish Powder rm & Laundry/mud rm complete the main flr. Upstairs there's a wonderful Family rm, 3-spacious sunny BRs & 2-full baths, while walkout Lower level has rec/playrm, versatile finished room, full bath, wine cellar, semi-fin space & huge amounts of storage. C/air, gas heat, 2-c gar, city water/sewers-coupled w/easy HOA living & main flr suite make this your ideal home!
